t: First ever BDT email on record sent by Hursty to fellow Inaugurals Ash, Boysie, BT, Langers No Wangers, Robbo & Paddy
The Inaugural Tourists fly to Marbella to commence the Inaugural Tour
Robbo introduces the Green Jacket (stolen from dad Barry's wardrobe!)
Boysie crowned inaugural tour champ and first winner of the Green Jacket
The second tour starts in La Manga. Debutant tourists are Boggy, Charlie, Marshy, Picko & Ravo
Ravo sings Your Song in the Piano Bar
Boggy purchases the Big Dogs Ryder Cup on Great Portland St and formulates the concept of the Big Dogs Ryder Cup
After a prolonged debate over email, Marshy coins the name "Big Dogs Tour"
In advance of BDT 2004, Boggy & Hursty decide upon the first ever Retriever & Bloodhound teams
BDT 2004 to Lagos. Buzz, Knoxy, Langrish & Little make their debuts
First team shirts with BDT logo unveiled
BDT 2005 to Vilamoura. Ollie Gregory & Purlo are the two debutants
Shitzu, Second Place, Third Place, LD and NTP trophies introduced
BDT 2006 to Mallorca, the first tour with no debutants
BDT 2007 to Dubai, the first tour to be held outside of Spain & Portugal. DT makes his debut
Robbo successfully retains the Green Jacket, still the only time this has been done
BDT 2008 to Lisbon (after a flirtation with Turkey)
The Finemaster makes his first formal appearance
The first BDT Preview Video is unveiled at the BDT 2008 OC
Paddy awarded the first tour MDE
The Great Dane, St Bernard, Rottweiler, Poodle, Bandit & Cheat Trophies are introduced
The Greyhound and Shitzu jerseys are worn for the first time
BDT 2009 to Vale do Lobo. Coxy makes his debut and goes on to win the Green Jacket
BDT 2010 to Girona. Fred and Gav make their debuts
First Match v TISSI at Celtic Manor
BDT 2011 to Miami, the 10th anniversary tour. Ollie Gobat makes his debut and Langers No Wangers returns to tour for the first time since the Inaugural Tour
Ollie Gobat wins the 10th anniversary Green Jacket
Robbo awarded the second tour MDE
BDT 2012 to Marbella. The first stay at Villa el Cano and the Taylors become the first pair of brothers to captain against each other
Boysie beats Robbo at Wilpshire to win the final home match and BDT 2012 for the Bloodhounds, the only tour to be settled on English soil
BDT 2013 to Marbella. Debut tour for Adam T, Harbo and Rob. The first 20-man tour
Second TISSI Match at Worplesdon
RIP Ollie Gobat
BDT 2014 to Marbella, the hat-trick stay at El Cano
The first ever tied tour concludes, with the teams finishing level at 10-10
BDT 2015 to Malmö. Debut tour for Drinky, Jules & Rufus
The Goblat is introduced at the 2015 OC
The Retrievers achieve the first ever Dogwash, winning all four fourballs points in one day
BDT 2016 to Mallorca. The 15th Anniversary Tour and the first to feature 24 tourists. Glenn, Lordy, Marcus & Rick make their debuts
Paddy wins his third Green Jacket, the first Green Jacket hat-trick, in the maiden BDT play-off for first place
BDT 2017 to Mallorca. Adam G, Hulmey & Tully make their debuts
BDT 2018 to Valencia
Ash & Boysie are awarded the third and fourth tour MDEs
BDT 2019 to Cyprus. The Parish brothers become the second pair of brothers to captain opposing teams
BDT 2020 to The Belfry. The first ever tour held in the UK, due to Covid
Buzz is awarded the fifth tour MDE
BDT 2021 to Celtic Manor. The 20th Anniversary Tour
Hursty is awarded the sixth tour MDE
BDT 2022 to Lagos. Kezza makes his debut
Charlie is awarded the seventh tour MDE
BDT 2023 to Turkey. Bean makes his debut
BDT 2024 to Turkey. Boysie wins his second Green Jacket after his first on the Inaugural Tour
BDT 2025 to Marrakech. Marshy wins his first Green Jacket. Buysai and Tom make their debuts
Buzz is appointed an honorary member of the Committee
BDT 2026 to Scottsdale, Arizona – the first tour in the USA since Miami in 2011. Kenners & Steve make their debuts
The Retrievers win the Big Dogs Ryder Cup 12½–11½, their second win in a row
Paddy wins his fourth Green Jacket, the most by any Big Dog
